shots.content: Inside a kitchen, a long rectangular island stands between the refrigerator wall and the sink area, with stools arranged along its sides. A woman in a navy blazer sits at the sink-side guest stool and speaks about the dinner schedule, while a man in a mustard sweater sits at the refrigerator-side guest stool, a woman in an emerald blouse sits at the sink-side cook stool, and a man in a charcoal hoodie sits at the refrigerator-side cook stool.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the refrigerator end, looking lengthwise along the kitchen island toward the sink area, with both guest-side stools and both cook-side stools in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a navy blazer at the sink-side guest stool exchanges seats with a man in a mustard sweater at the refrigerator-side guest stool, then she asks a question and he answers.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the cook side, centered on the two adjacent guest-side stools.

shots.content: A woman in an emerald blouse asks for details, and a man in a charcoal hoodie replies.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the sink end, looking lengthwise along the kitchen island toward the refrigerator wall, with both guest-side stools and both cook-side stools in frame.
